fields.title: Data is protected according to its sensitivity

sections.Purpose: We classify data by how sensitive it is, and handle each class accordingly. Personal data adds the obligations we owe to the people it describes.
sections.Scope:
All data kept or processed by systems we build or operate, in every environment, including backups, exports, logs, analytical copies and test data.

_Boundary: [pol-ENVS](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/7912e0bf3bf4296cc127ccd8a8fb0d558179fbae/examples/engineering/policies/security/envs-environment-separation.md#clauses) governs the separation between the environments this data moves through, and [pol-SCRT](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/7912e0bf3bf4296cc127ccd8a8fb0d558179fbae/examples/engineering/policies/security/scrt-secrets-management.md#clauses) governs the secrets that protect it. [pol-INCR](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/7912e0bf3bf4296cc127ccd8a8fb0d558179fbae/examples/engineering/policies/operations/incr-incident-response.md) owns recording a personal data breach and notifying it. This policy owns what the data itself requires, in whichever environment it is kept._
sections.Exceptions:
Where a defect genuinely cannot be reproduced without production data, a time-boxed, access-restricted copy is allowed under a recorded deviation ([pol-DEVI](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/7912e0bf3bf4296cc127ccd8a8fb0d558179fbae/examples/engineering/policies/governance/devi-deviations.md)) that names who approved it, who can see it and when it will be destroyed. Legal hold overrides deletion, and is recorded when it does.

`LAWFUL` admits no exception. A recorded deviation can answer where personal data is copied and for how long. It cannot answer whether we were entitled to hold that data at all.
